stories.title: USA: Trump fordert nach Deal mit Putin einen neuen Staatschef für die Ukraine

en.title: USA: Trump calls for new Ukrainian leader after Putin deal
en.summary: Before midterm elections, the US President aims to lower fuel prices, potentially at Ukraine's expense, and is distancing himself more clearly from the country.

stories.title: Ukrainekrieg: Trump attackiert Selenskyj und will Führungswechsel in der Ukraine

en.title: Ukraine war: Trump attacks Zelenskyy and wants leadership change in Ukraine
en.summary: US President Trump demands an end to attacks on Russian oil facilities and suggests a peace deal could be reached with a different Ukrainian president.

stories.title: Saudi-Arabien: Mindestens zwölf Tote bei Angriff auf Flughafen in Riad

en.title: Saudi Arabia: At least twelve dead in attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: A suspected Houthi militia attack on Riyadh airport resulted in multiple deaths and hundreds of injuries, forcing the suspension of flight operations.

stories.title: Saudi-Arabien: Viele Tote bei Angriff auf Flughafen in Riad

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Many dead in attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport, which serves approximately 40 million passengers annually, resulted in at least twelve deaths, with diplomats suspecting Houthi militia involvement.

stories.title: Eklat nach KREML-Deal: Für Putins Diesel lässt Trump Selenskyj wieder fallen

en.title: Scandal after Kremlin deal: Trump abandons Zelenskyy again for Putin's diesel
en.summary: Facing difficult congressional election prospects, the US President prioritizes an energy deal with Putin over supporting Ukraine's leader.

stories.title: Trump fordert nach Dieseldeal mit Putin Selenskyjs Ablösung

en.title: Trump calls for Zelenskyy's removal following diesel deal with Putin
en.summary: After announcing a diesel deal with Russia, Trump called for the replacement of Ukrainian President Zelenskyy, blaming him for high energy prices. Ukraine responded with outrage to the announced agreement.

stories.title: Ukraine: Donald Trump fordert Machtwechsel in Kiew nach Diesel-Streit

en.title: Ukraine: Donald Trump Calls for Leadership Change in Kyiv Following Diesel Dispute
en.summary: US President Trump responded sharply to President Zelenskyy's criticism of Trump's diesel agreement with Putin, stating that Ukraine should have a new president.

stories.title: Liveblog Ukrainekrieg: Trump: „Es ist Zeit, dass die Ukraine einen neuen Präsidenten bekommt“

en.title: Live Blog Ukraine War: Trump: "It's Time for Ukraine to Get a New President"
en.summary: US President Trump states the war should never have started as talks between Ukraine and the US end early. Germany's government reaffirms its commitment to Russian sanctions.

stories.title: Saudi-Arabien: Huthis greifen erneut Flughafen in Riad an – zwölf Tote und Hunderte Verletzte

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Huthis attack Riyadh airport again – twelve dead and hundreds injured
en.summary: Iran-backed Houthi militants launched a rocket attack on Saudi Arabia's main airport in Riyadh, resulting in multiple deaths and numerous injuries. The German government warned against travel through Riyadh.

stories.title: Donald Trump: Expertin erwartet kaum Preiswirkung nach Diesel-Deal

en.title: Donald Trump: Expert expects little price impact from diesel deal
en.summary: The U.S. president has arranged diesel deliveries with the Russian leader. An expert suggests this agreement will have minimal effect on global market prices.

stories.title: „Symbolische Handlung“: Trumps Diesel-Deal dürfte die Preise kaum ändern

en.title: "Symbolic gesture": Trump's diesel deal is unlikely to change prices
en.summary: The US President announced a diesel agreement with Putin, but experts believe it will have little effect on global market prices.

stories.title: Newsblog zur Bundespolitik: Nach Trumps Diesel-Deal: Bundesregierung will an Sanktionen festhalten

en.title: News blog on German federal politics: After Trump's diesel deal, federal government wants to maintain sanctions
en.summary: Germany's government acknowledged the U.S. decision regarding Russian diesel supplies while indicating it intends to keep its own sanctions in place.

stories.title: USA: Trump verkündet Diesel-Deal mit Kreml-Chef Putin

en.title: USA: Trump announces diesel deal with Kremlin chief Putin
en.summary: President Trump stated that Russia should bring over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to American and global markets. Ukraine responded with sharp criticism.

stories.title: Tech-Szene: San Francisco wird im KI-Boom zum Sehnsuchtsort junger Deutscher

en.title: Tech scene: San Francisco becomes a place of longing for young Germans in the AI boom
en.summary: Young Germans with doctorates and corporate careers are relocating to Silicon Valley to pursue wealth in the artificial intelligence sector amid record capital inflows.

stories.title: CDU: „CDU pur ist gescheitert“ – Vor der Klausur wächst der Druck auf Merz

en.title: CDU: "CDU pure has failed" – Pressure on Merz grows ahead of retreat
en.summary: The CDU's top leadership body meets to address the party's deepest crisis to date. Multiple voices are calling for a change in direction away from what some call the "Merz ultras."

stories.title: Arbeitnehmerhaftung: Wie ein Gerichtsurteil leitende Angestellte in den Ruin treiben könnte

en.title: Employee liability: How a court ruling could financially ruin senior executives
en.summary: A court decision potentially increases liability risks for senior managers, exposing their personal assets to claims if they cause damages during their work.

stories.title: EU-Haushalt: Neuer Budget-Plan verschärft Streit mit Nettozahlern

en.title: EU budget: New budget plan intensifies dispute with net contributors
en.summary: A new proposal for the next long-term EU budget has been presented, prompting Chancellor Merz to reject it amid disagreements over funding levels.
